opening_context: downloaded local HTML file opened directly

rich_html_copy.primary: navigator.clipboard.write with ClipboardItem invoked directly in the click handler
rich_html_copy.fallback: document.execCommand copy using a temporary off-screen contenteditable element

locked_invariants: one complete rich-HTML payload unless a real destination test proves a split necessary
transfer wrapper is div dir=auto class=body markup
only contenteditable=false and draggable=true are removed from transferable native objects
ClipboardItem is invoked directly from the click handler with no pre-clipboard asynchronous work
rendered comment cards become canonical URLs in the same source positions
images, digest previews, YouTube/video, Share, and Subscribe remain rich HTML under their per-type status
manual paywall instruction appears only when a genuine raw-source marker exists
payload is rebuilt from the exact final archival editor body
supersession_reason: Joel's destination testing showed comment URL reconstruction can coexist with one complete rich-HTML payload; prior image/digest regressions came from changing the rich-copy path, not from the comment strategy.
last_destination_status: The one-paste path and object-specific conversions are the current confirmed design; every regenerated final helper still requires a fresh Opera-to-Substack destination check.
